Mojo AI Summits Partner Pricing Structure

Executive access is structured as a stackable subscription per Executive slot. Each subscription buys one Executive slot, which may be assigned to one approved director-level-or-above executive guest or executive member at a time according to the substitution rules in the partner agreement.

View Partner Tiers View Candidate Pricing
Per Executive Slot

One subscribed slot admits one approved executive guest or executive member at a time.

Annual Contract

The purchase price may be paid quarterly during the annual term.

Director Level or Above

Each approved executive guest or executive member must meet the director-level threshold.

Positioning Principle

What the Partnership Buys

Mojo AI Summits does not sell booths, badge scans, logo packages, or attendee lists. Your organization subscribes Executive slots into a curated executive intelligence network with access to approved Mojo virtual events, summits, and specialty events according to each subscription tier.

Trusted proximity, not lead capture

Mojo creates access to serious executive rooms where trust, relevance, and repeated participation matter more than badge scans.

Executive contribution, not demo theater

Your role is to improve the quality of the conversation instead of turning the room into a sales presentation.

Relationship intelligence, not attendee lists

Mojo focuses on context, shared participation history, appropriate follow-up paths, and consent-aware relationship development.

Partner profile, not scattered activity

Your profile gives your team one private record of partner engagements, partner publications, and executives engaged through partner-supported events.

Annual partnership, not one-off event spend

The value compounds across virtual events, summits, specialty events, and ongoing executive intelligence.

Curated participation, not open inventory

Mojo protects the executive room by matching partner participation to credibility, topic fit, and contribution value.

Partner Candidate

Candidate Pricing

Partner Candidate is the pre-approval qualification stage. Partner Candidate means your organization is not yet an approved Partner. Candidate pricing applies while your organization remains in Candidate status, and Partner discounts are not available until your organization is approved as a Partner.

Candidate Access Level Candidate Price Billing Basis Access
Tier 1(Research Partner) $2,500 per quarter Per quarter Unlimited Mojo virtual event attendance
Tier 2(Summit Partner) $6,500 per quarter Per quarter Unlimited Mojo virtual event attendance plus summit attendance
Tier 3(Strategic Partner) $13,000 per quarter Per quarter, annual subscription Virtual event attendance, summit attendance, and broader eligible Mojo executive engagement beginning in Q2 2027

Candidate pricing is applied to each subscribed Executive slot while your organization remains in Candidate status. Partner discounts do not apply during the Candidate period.

Subscription Ladder

Partner Tier Pricing

Each Executive slot must be subscribed individually. One subscribed Executive slot admits one approved executive guest or executive member at a time. Approved executive guests and executive members must be director level or above.

Partner Page Tier Subscription Function Price Per Executive Slot Billing Basis Access
Tier 1(Research Partner) Virtual event subscription $1,500 Per quarter Unlimited Mojo virtual event attendance
Tier 2(Summit Partner) Summit attendance subscription $5,000 total Per quarter Unlimited Mojo virtual event attendance plus Mojo summit attendance
Tier 3(Strategic Partner) Full Mojo event subscription $10,000 total Per quarter, annual subscription Unlimited virtual event attendance, summit attendance, and eligible Mojo events above and beyond Tier 1 and Tier 2

Featured Partner virtual event sponsorship: Tier 1 virtual-event partners may sponsor a particular approved Mojo virtual event at a Featured Partner rate of $1,500 per virtual event. This rate is separate from the quarterly Executive-slot attendance subscription.

Payment Terms

Annual Contract, Quarterly Payments

Partner subscriptions are annual contracts. The purchase price may be paid quarterly during the annual contract term. Quarterly payment does not convert the subscription into a quarter-to-quarter commitment.

If you pay the annual subscription in full at the start of the contract term, you receive a 10% annual payment discount.

Payment Option Discount Pricing Treatment
Quarterly payments 0% Standard annual contract price paid quarterly
Annual payment upfront 10% 10% discount for paying the annual subscription in full at the start of the term
Discounts

Executive Slot and Executive Member Status Discounts

Discounts are applied per Executive slot. Your agreement will show the active subscription tier, slot-count discount, and member-status discount for each subscribed Executive slot.

Partner discounts are available only after your organization is approved as a Partner. Partner Candidates do not receive Partner discounts during the Candidate period.

Executive Slot Discounts

Executive Slot Discount Pricing Treatment
First Executive slot 0% Standard subscription price
Second Executive slot 15% 15% discount on that slot's subscription fee
Third Executive slot and beyond 30% 30% discount on each additional slot's subscription fee

Executive Member Status Discounts

Executive Member Status Discount Pricing Treatment
Tier 3 member 10% 10% discount for that Executive slot
Tier 4 member 20% 20% discount for that Executive slot

SMB Program

Qualified SMB Partner Candidates and Partners

Partner Candidates and Partners with a market cap below $1 million may qualify for the SMB program. Qualified SMB Partner Candidates and Partners pay 50% of the applicable Partner subscription price for each subscribed Executive slot.

Access Level Standard Quarterly Cost SMB Quarterly Cost What It Covers
Tier 1 $1,500 $750 Unlimited virtual event attendance
Tier 2 $5,000 $2,500 Unlimited virtual event attendance plus summit attendance
Tier 3 $10,000 $5,000 Unlimited virtual event attendance, summit attendance, and eligible Mojo events beyond Tier 1 and Tier 2

If your organization is both a Partner Candidate and SMB-qualified, your agreement will specify whether Candidate pricing or SMB program pricing applies during the qualification period.

Tier Details

Partner Page Tiers

Tier 1: Research Partner

$1,500 per quarter per Executive slot

Attendance-only access to Mojo virtual events for the executive guest or executive member using your subscribed slot during the active subscription period.

  • Virtual event access for one approved executive guest or executive member using the subscribed slot
  • Participation in approved online executive sessions
  • Access to recurring Mojo virtual programming
  • Mojo relationship tracking for participation through the Executive slot
  • Does not include keynote-address pricing or pricing for actual sponsorship

Tier 2: Summit Partner

$5,000 total per quarter per Executive slot

Attendance-only access to Mojo summit programming for the executive guest or executive member using your subscribed slot during the active subscription period.

  • Summit attendance access for one approved executive guest or executive member using the subscribed slot
  • Participation in approved summit programming
  • Mojo relationship tracking for summit participation
  • Eligibility to purchase Tier 3 Strategic Partner access
  • Does not include keynote-address pricing or pricing for actual sponsorship

Tier 3: Strategic Partner

$10,000 total per quarter per Executive slot

Strategic Partner access is for broader eligible Mojo executive engagement beyond Tier 1 virtual attendance and Tier 2 summit attendance. This level becomes available in Q2 2027 under an annual subscription commitment.

  • Access to eligible specialty events, partner events, executive experiences, and additional approved executive engagement formats beginning in Q2 2027
  • Priority consideration for strategic partner programming once Strategic Partner access opens
  • Mojo relationship tracking for broader Mojo event participation
  • Strategic relationship visibility across the subscribed Executive slot's participation history
Agreement Details

What the Partner Agreement Specifies

  • Partner company name
  • Partner or Partner Candidate status
  • SMB program eligibility, when applicable
  • Number of Executive slots
  • Approved executive guest or executive member assignment for each slot
  • Confirmation that each approved executive guest or executive member is director level or above
  • Subscription tier for each Executive slot
  • Featured Partner virtual event sponsorship rate and approved event assignment, when applicable
  • Candidate pricing, when applicable
  • Partner discount eligibility, when applicable
  • Slot-count discount for each eligible Executive slot
  • Member-status discount for each eligible Executive slot
  • Start date and renewal date
  • Quarterly billing terms for Tier 1 and Tier 2
  • Quarterly billing terms for Tier 3 under the annual subscription
  • Annual contract term with quarterly payment schedule, when selected
  • Annual payment discount, when selected
  • Event categories included and excluded
  • Substitution rules for Executive slot assignments
  • Conduct and trust standards
  • Data sharing and relationship visibility rules

Mojo AI Summits uses a per-Executive slot subscription model. Tier 1 Research Partner access is $1,500 per quarter for virtual event attendance only. Tier 1 virtual-event partners may also sponsor a particular approved Mojo virtual event at a Featured Partner rate of $1,500 per virtual event. This sponsorship rate is separate from the quarterly Executive-slot attendance subscription. Tier 2 Summit Partner access is $5,000 per quarter for virtual event access plus summit attendance only. Tier 3 Strategic Partner access is $10,000 per quarter under an annual subscription for broader eligible Mojo executive engagement beginning in Q2 2027. Partner Candidate means your organization is not yet an approved Partner, so Partner discounts do not apply until approval.
